metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Three periods: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Nassau County, New York (approximate center: -73.5594, 40.7891) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.75) to filter valid NO2 measurements - This is about NO2 concentration, not clouds, so quality masking is appropriate 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: If mean NO2 in 2021 is genuinely lower than both 2018 and 2019 → A - Not lower (higher or similar) → B - C1: If any of the three collections is empty - C2: If after quality masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Nassau County, NY const nassau = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.5594, 40.7891]).buffer(20000); // 20km buffer // 2. Define time periods const periods = [ {year: 2018, start: '2018-10-01', end: '2018-10-24'}, {year: 2019, start: '2019-10-01', end: '2019-10-24'}, {year: 2021, start: '2021-10-01', end: '2021-10-24'} ]; // 3. Function to get NO2 data function getNO2(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(nassau) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); } const results = {}; // 4. Process each period for (const period of periods) { const col = getNO2(period.start, period.end); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`No images for ${period.year}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 const meanImg = col.mean(); const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nassau, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanVal = stats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count = stats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; if (count === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${period.year}`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined || isNaN(meanVal)) { console.log(`Invalid calculation for ${period.year}`); console.log('C3'); return; } results[period.year] = {mean: meanVal, count: count, images: size}; console.log(`${period.year}: Images=${size}, Mean NO2=${meanVal.toExponential(3)}, Pixels=${count}`); } // 5. Compare 2021 with 2018 and 2019 const lower2018 = results[2021].mean < results[2018].mean; const lower2019 = results[2021].mean < results[2019].mean; console.log(`2021 < 2018: ${lower2018}, 2021 < 2019: ${lower2019}`); if (lower2018 && lower2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```

2018: Images=314, Mean NO2=9.647e-5, Pixels=1727
2019: Images=327, Mean NO2=1.223e-4, Pixels=1727
2021: Images=325, Mean NO2=1.118e-4, Pixels=1727
2021 < 2018: false, 2021 < 2019: true
<answer>B</answer>
